At ENGIE, we believe technology is a powerful lever for the energy transition. Our cloud infrastructure supports critical operations that help deliver cleaner energy solutions worldwide. We are looking for a Cloud Expert to join our Global Business Support team and ensure our platforms remain secure, available, and future-ready.
You will play a central role in managing and optimizing our Azure and AWS environments. Your expertise will directly impact business continuity, security compliance, and the satisfaction of our internal customers across multiple entities.
 What You'll Do
 Manage and operate Azure and AWS cloud environments, ensuring high availability and security compliance aligned with ENGIE Group policies.
 Deploy and administer IaaS and PaaS services, including VMs, containers, and serverless architectures, in collaboration with cloud partners.
 Provide Level 1 to 3 operational support on cloud platforms, Windows, and Linux servers, resolving incidents efficiently.
 Automate infrastructure deployment and management using Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Jenkins, and CI/CD pipelines.
 Monitor and supervise existing infrastructures with tools such as Grafana and Azure Monitor Agent, identifying and resolving technical issues proactively.
 Advise and support business units during go-to-run processes, sharing deep cloud expertise and ensuring quality of deliverables.
 Write and maintain technical documentation, architecture files, and root cause analyses to ensure traceability and auditability.
 What You Bring
 4 to 10 years of experience in cloud operations with strong expertise in Azure and AWS (IaaS, PaaS, containers, serverless).
 Solid knowledge of AWS services including S3, EC2, Lambda, IAM, RDS, VPC, ECS, and EKS.
 Proficiency in DevOps tooling: Docker, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Terraform, Bicep, and JIRA.
 Strong scripting skills in PowerShell, Python, or Bash, with experience in databases such as PostgreSQL, CosmosDB, SQL Server, or Oracle.
 Mandatory certifications: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) and AWS Solutions Architect Associate.
 Fluency in English (B2 minimum, spoken and written); French B2 is a plus.
 Ability to work in a multicultural, cross-functional team with strong communication and knowledge-sharing skills.
 On-call duty and interventions during non-working hours are required.
 What We Offer
 A competitive salary package reflecting your expertise and certifications.
 Career growth through diverse missions across cloud technologies, automation, and security.
 Stimulating work on critical infrastructure supporting the energy transition at a global scale.
 A friendly, collaborative team environment within a multicultural organization.
 Flexibility and work-life balance through our hybrid working model.
 Access to continuous learning, certifications, and professional development opportunities.
 Only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted. 
 If you decide to send us your personal information in order to apply for this position, please be aware of our job candidate GDPR Data Privacy Notice: https://www.engie.ro/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/ER_Nota-de-informare-Candidati.pdf .
 Our Commitment
 At ENGIE, every talent has a role to play in accelerating the energy transition. Make a difference and enjoy a fulfilling professional experience. Take on exciting challenges and build a career path that reflects who you are. Join us and be part of the adventure of the century!
ENGIE is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants based on their skills, experience, and potential. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, age, disability, sexual orientation, religion, or any other protected characteristic. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone belongs.
If you require reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know. We are happy to support you in presenting your best self.
